acceptance.definition: Independent seeded lens effect; native, authoring, persistence, raster, preview, actual editor history and its 640x360 same-project video checks have passed. The separate 192x128 production oracle video acceptance remains open.
blocking: The 192x128 production six-frame VP9 decode exceeds the unchanged quality gates on frame 5. Passing 640x360 same-project export does not supersede it.
acceptance.history: Each evidence record describes its own frozen inputs and scope. Later results must be appended explicitly; diagnostic encodes do not replace failed production runs.

cpu.scope: Catalog, strict admission, raw uniforms, independent seed/geometry vectors and signed rational frame/phase behavior.

gpu.scope: Real texture refraction, alpha/hidden RGB, exact no-op, frame/seed/seek determinism and invalid raw-pass rejection; not browser hardware WebGPU.

nativeTests.counting: The two seven-test CPU runs are repeats, not fourteen distinct passing tests. The v2 record compiled GPU tests only; the separate GPU run executed all five.

creatorAuthoring.scope: Complete image resource, independent source/effect seeds, eight static controls and attached amount/refraction/highlight keyframes; strict ranges without caller mutation.
creatorAuthoring.limits: Packaging uses real copy script with main/renderer entry stubs, not executable bundle or installed-plugin validation. Existing unrelated no-unsafe-finally lint failure remains in the packaging test cleanup guard.

hostPersistence.scope: All eight controls, three attached optical channels, inclusive bounds, offline imported resource and exact memory/revision/disk preservation after invalid multi-operation batches.
hostPersistence.limits: Host reopen within one test process, not fresh OS process or UI acceptance.

browserRaster.scope: Native effect resolver/raster at landscape and portrait sizes with opaque, holes and transparent legal canvas inputs. Raw frame candidates are not encoded video acceptance.

preview.scope: Real CanvasRenderer/WasmCompositor: attached and effect-layer placements, start/end boundaries, offset/trim invariance, three attached optical animations, repeat/reverse seeks and full alpha-frame replacement.

codecDiagnosis.observed: VP9 Profile 0 yuv420p, full-range BT709/sRGB, six correctly ordered 192x128 frames at 30 fps and 0.2 seconds. Default FFmpeg decode also fails the unchanged active-RGB quality gate.
codecDiagnosis.inference: Failure is downstream of correct raster rendering in the production encode/color-conversion/reconstruction path. Blue chroma dominates the error; the recorded bitstream does not isolate RGB-to-I420 sampling from encoder decisions.
codecDiagnosis.controls: Alternative encodes and chroma reconstruction controls are diagnosis only. No transformed reference, threshold change or diagnostic video is treated as production acceptance.

controlledEncodingDiagnosis.conclusion: Bitrate affects later-frame quality but increasing it alone does not pass the unchanged independent decoder gate. RGB-to-I420 sampling and chroma reconstruction remain to be investigated; no production bitrate change was made.
controlledEncodingDiagnosis.initializationFailures: Retained Vite 504 Outdated Optimize Dep failures occurred before any encoder or capability query. Import-only warmup was recorded separately; they are not bitrate failures.

editor.transport: Actual Host staticDir and authenticated URL; attached editor task runner.
editor.keyframeScope: Host-authored channels rendered by the actual editor; three sample times, reverse seeks and reload.
editor.knownNoise: Two expected graph-editor user-presets HTTP 404 console entries; no external requests. Build warnings are retained in the run evidence.

initialSameProjectExport.source: The project from the preceding real editor UI run, reopened for export with the same private WASM.
initialSameProjectExport.failure: No integer full-canvas geometry in the 16 attempted viewport combinations; no export checks completed. Subsequent host diagnostics also report the missing project-before-export.json that this aborted flow never created.

sameProjectExport.source: The original run-d74IEd UI-edited project and original editor-dist; no project recreation, parameter replay or WASM replacement.

geometry.policy: Select the first complete integer canvas from a predeclared 1440-wide, 1000..1127-high viewport list before pixel references or encoding.
geometry.reference: All pixels of the complete neutral UI canvas normalized to 640x360; same bounds and filter for baseline and six frames. Not an independent optical solver reference.

persistence.uiStageChanges: Only metadata and summary updatedAt; 1600ms disk quiet before the export baseline.

sameProjectExport.knownNoise: One optional user-presets 404 and unavailable WebGPU adapter; external requests and page errors zero.

retainedFailures.reason: Earlier private gate run lacked TypeScript and editor-classic migration links. The later nOdShH gate run passed; this failed run remains retained.

First pipeline oracle expected transparent inactive pixels, while production correctly clears opaque black; all 24576 alpha values differed. The owned oracle was corrected without changing production or thresholds.
Additive black-composition ordering correction evidence: six CPU tests, 15668 assertions, strict TS/lint/UTF-8 checks; unchanged thresholds and opaque codec references.

notClaimed: Passing the 192x128 production oracle VP9 export; it remains a separate failed check despite the passing 640x360 same-edited-project video.
Installed Creator Studio/Rocut plugin, Electron runtime or hardware browser WebGPU validation.
UI creation of optical keyframes, or any effect-layer animation support.
Alpha-preserving video, all-codec/all-backend coverage, performance or resource/latency bounds.
Whole current worktree build, shared dependency replacement, commit, push, release or completion of the overall goal.

isolation.method: Private source snapshots and package, real scoped production paths and independent references; manifests retain the consumed inputs and their hashes.
